prompt: Design an Eid Refresh campaign for LIVANA. Celebrate Eid with a fresh skin glow — position Livana as the go-to beauty bar for the festive season. Feature the Livana soap bar as the hero (40–60% of layout) on a sage green and neutral botanical canvas. Bilingual layout: Hind Siliguri Bengali headline as the lead, Inclusive Sans English sub-label. Reference the three core active ingredients: Aloe Vera, Vitamin E, and Sandalwood. Include a 30% Eid offer badge styled with pill-shaped CTA. Bengali headline: 'ঈদের সতেজতা, LIVANA-এর সাথে।' English sub-copy: 'Crafted for Bangladeshi skin. Every day, every wash.' Tone: fresh, celebratory, science-backed, radically accessible.

Hind Siliguri text fades in: 'ঈদের সতেজতা।' Camera pulls back to show Aloe Vera, Vitamin E capsule, and sandalwood icons appearing around the product. Flat, clean aesthetic — no heavy shadows.
